data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, **I'd recommend Stripe for most businesses**, unless you're already using Shopify—in which case Shopify Payments is usually the simplest and most cost-effective starting point.

The best choice depends on three things: transaction fees, how easy it is to integrate, and how much control you want over checkout.

Here are the options I'd shortlist.

## Best payment processors compared

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- UK card fees: approximately 1.5% + 20p
- No monthly processing fee
- Excellent website integrations
- Supports subscriptions, Apple Pay and Google Pay

Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and growing online stores.

[Stripe pricing](https://stripe.com/gb/pricing)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simple payment and refund management
- No additional third-party transaction fee when using Shopify Payments
- Rates depend on your Shopify subscription

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![PayPal Community Blog | WebMCP is here: PayPal is helping every merchant become agent-ready](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/m5ug143CLBMTx58QHX87tR0yp_mut01Jfcef-TrwDZlKGOkQj11A-BfIsS68RYX8ZEhrlYF0VdtP2FJxdikuQMj8BdtYX7SkRjN15lCWV9oz8yKGe3bBXL9Y5wfUx2pGPru15kfPn8wgsc8XcjOgFB-OJoWMzvMKUjY252LWdpsT8G6VlvrSqapzfkmpLi6y?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers
- Customers can pay using PayPal or eligible cards
- Useful as an additional checkout option
- Often more expensive than Stripe for standard card payments

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online fees around 1.4% + 25p for UK cards
- Free basic online selling tools
- Excellent if you also sell in person

[Square payments](https://squareup.com/gb/en/payments)

Indicative UK pricing based on published 2026 comparisons. International cards, premium cards and other payment methods can cost more. [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-online-payment-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.intelivita.co.uk](https://www.intelivita.co.uk/blog/best-online-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whito.co.uk](https://whito.co.uk/tools/best-payment-processors-for-uk-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a typical small online store, I'd choose\:

- **Stripe** if you have WooCommerce or a custom website.
- **Shopify Payments** if you use Shopify.
- **PayPal alongside your main processor** to give customers another familiar way to pay.

## Three questions to find the best fit

I can narrow this down considerably with three details\:

**1\. What platform does your store use?**

Shopify

WooCommerce / WordPress

Wix / Squarespace

Custom-built website

Not built yet

---

**2\. Expected monthly online sales?**

Under £5,000

£5,000–£20,000

£20,000–£100,000

Over £100,000

---

**3\. Where are most of your customers?**

Mostly UK

UK and Europe

Worldwide

With those answers, I can recommend the best processor and estimate how much you'll actually pay in transaction fees each month.
